sources.role: pinned posix-frontends commit (matches docs/DESMUME_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md pin); all path and naming facts below were verified identical at this commit for the core, posix, windows and cocoa frontends
controller contract: GLib keyfile [JOYKEYS] at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/desmume/config, joypad key encoding, private XDG_CONFIG_HOME launch
official download page: Windows 0.9.13 release + nightly builds; links the wiki FAQ
.dsv save-file format and default save locations (0.9.5+ ~/.config/desmume on Linux/macOS, emulator directory on Windows)
flatpak application id org.desmume.DeSmuME (manifest builds the posix GTK frontend from a master commit, last updated 2024-09-26)

paths.path: ~/.config/desmume/config — a GLib keyfile (not desmume.cfg/.ini) at g_get_user_config_dir()/desmume/config; $XDG_CONFIG_HOME overrides the root, and the posix keyfile is where the [JOYKEYS] joypad group lives: one integer per key_names[] entry (Up/Down/Left/Right/A/B/X/Y/L/R/Start/Select plus disabled 0xFFFF entries), with codes (device & 15) << 12 | type << 8 | index (type 0=Axis, 1=Hat, 2=Button; axis halves 2*axis / 2*axis+1 engage at |value| >> 14 = 16384)

source:frontend/posix/shared/ctrlssdl.cpp joypad key-code encoding and 16384 axis threshold @b3915949
contract:docs/DESMUME_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md (JOYKEYS keyfile + private XDG_CONFIG_HOME isolation)
db:firmware_rules — no desmume entries (sources/firmware-rules.json has no runtime_kind desmume; no BIOS/firmware package is modeled)

paths.path: ~/.config/desmume/<rom>.dsv — the battery directory defaults to the same module directory g_build_filename(g_get_user_config_dir(), "desmume") (the posix frontends do NOT use Windows' Battery/ subfolders); a .dsv.bak rolling backup sits next to it and a raw <rom>.sav is imported when no .dsv exists
paths.naming: <ROM filename without extension>.dsv (DeSmuME's own .dsv container holding the cart backup memory), <rom>.dsv.bak backup, and legacy import from <rom>.sav
evidence: source:mc.cpp:238-239 path.getpathnoext(path.BATTERY) + ".dsv", :251 ".dsv.bak", :280 .sav fallback @b3915949

source:path.cpp:217-221 posix LoadModulePath = g_get_user_config_dir()/desmume (mkdir'd), :230-231 non-Windows GetDefaultPath falls back to that module dir, :274 ReadKeyW(pathToBattery, BATTERYKEY) @b3915949
docs:wiki Faq — 'In 0.9.5, the default location for .dsv files changed ... in OSX/Linux it is ~/.config/desmume'

paths.path: ~/.config/desmume/<rom>.ds0 through <rom>.ds9 — savestate slots live directly in the config module dir (STATE_SLOTS default is the same dir on posix); File > Save State To... instead asks for a file (filter *.ds*, proposed name save.ds); before each loadstate a rolling backup is written as .dst into '<statefile> (backups)/' with a backup.index counter — so slots are .ds#, and .dst is the backup/older 'save as' extension, not the slot format
paths.naming: <ROM filename without extension>.ds<slot 0-9> (NB_STATES=10) in the STATE_SLOTS directory; explicit saves are any user-named .ds file; pre-load rolling backups are '<rom>.ds<N> (backups)/<index>.dst' plus backup.index (BackupSavesMax, default on with 200 entries)
evidence: source:saves.cpp:798-817 scan_savestates snprintf ".ds%d" over NB_STATES slots, :832-853 savestate_slot writes path.STATE_SLOTS + ".ds%d", :933-946 loadstate backup dir + backup.index + ".dst" @b3915949

paths.path: none required — the ARM7/ARM9 BIOS is built in (no bios7/bios9 dumping exists in the codebase); the only optional firmware is an external dumped-DS firmware.bin (CommonSettings.ExtFirmwarePath defaults to "firmware.bin", used only when external firmware is enabled, with BootFromFirmware defaulting to false; the cli frontend accepts -fw-path)
evidence: source:NDSSystem.cpp:3373-3375 strncpy(ExtFirmwarePath, "firmware.bin", ...) and BootFromFirmware = false, :2785-2793 external firmware only consulted when UseExtFirmware @b3915949
source:commandline.cpp:463 -fw-path sets UseExtFirmware/ExtFirmwarePath @b3915949
source: no bios7/bios9/nds BIOS-dump loading anywhere in src (grep over the pinned tree)

linux.notes: Lunchbox's desmume native launch pins the controller contract and isolates the whole config dir through a private XDG_CONFIG_HOME (docs/DESMUME_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md), which also relocates the default battery/state-slot directory.

paths.path: org.desmume.DeSmuME: ~/.var/app/org.desmume.DeSmuME/config/desmume/config — the manifest builds the same posix GTK frontend from a master commit (91196788eb6f8543ea395ac1f6ad9e056dc7c5c2, runtime 24.08, -Dfrontend-cli=false, command desmume), so the GLib keyfile and its [JOYKEYS] group land under the sandbox XDG_CONFIG_HOME; the Flathub appstream metadata still advertises release 0.9.11 (2015) even though the manifest was updated 2024-09-26

paths.path: desmume.ini in the executable's directory (portable style, written with a UTF-16 BOM); when the exe runs from the temp directory (e.g. straight out of an archive) it switches to %LOCALAPPDATA%\DeSmuME\desmume.ini and chdirs there; [PathSettings] keys Roms/Battery/SramImportExport/States/StateSlots/Screenshots/AviFiles/Cheats/SoundSamples/Firmware/Lua/Slot1D configure every data dir; joypad mapping lives in the Windows frontend's own ini sections — the [JOYKEYS] keyfile contract is posix-only

windows.notes: Windows is the only frontend using the Battery/States/StateSlots/Firmware subfolder layout, and only because its defaults are cwd-relative; desmume.org/download distributes 0.9.13 and nightly x64 builds.

macos.notes: The Cocoa frontend versions its data tree per CFBundleVersion (e.g. 0.9.13), so upgrades create a fresh Battery/States set; desmume.org's download page no longer hosts macOS builds ('You will have to ask the Internet for it, since the developer's website has vanished').
